title: Your Dhanteras necklace: how the jeweller really earns 💍
description:
Why is your gold bill more than the gold? Here's where the jewellery shop really makes its money.
A ₹1 lakh necklace with an assumed 10% making charge, computed: what you pay on top, and what you don't get back when you sell. No jeweller named; the charge is an example, not a rule. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
